name: Mei
description: A prayer-born warrior whose final form awakens beneath the edge of defeat.

ability.name: Final Form
ability.flavor: Below 70% HP, prayer becomes transformation: heal, gain +200% attack, and surge with defensive power. Her seal also catches a killing blow twice per battle, weaker the second time. The third one lands.

name: Kisuke Urahara
description: The smiling shopkeeper who reshapes the battlefield with one ruthless cut.

ability.name: Tear / Reshape
ability.flavor: Inflicts a severe percentage-based bleed that is difficult to cure.

name: Wither
description: An ash-crowned arbiter who passes sentence in embers. What she names, burns.

ability.name: Cinder Verdict
ability.flavor: Once per battle, no MP: sentences the enemy to an 8x INT-scaled pyre. Defense still mitigates it.

name: Willow
description: A quiet battle advisor who sees the strongest move before anyone else.

ability.name: Battle Advisor
ability.flavor: Reads the enemy and recommends the single most effective move without taking a turn.

name: Miyashi
description: Dragon-marked and glacial. Where she stands, the air itself turns against you.

ability.name: Absolute Zero
ability.flavor: Her aura alone burns the enemy and freezes their options down to a single blunt attack, and the closer they get to death, the harder it bites.

name: Nisha
description: Bonded to her dragon in blood. Attacks slip past her like smoke, and every clash feeds her more.

ability.name: Absolute One
ability.flavor: Nearly untouchable in a fight, and every turn she draws a little more life from whoever is foolish enough to still be standing.

name: Yoriichi
description: She does not fight for herself. When her owner falls, she is the one who refuses to let it end there.

ability.name: Cat Form Awakening
ability.flavor: The moment her master falls, Yoriichi comes to life and takes the fight over completely. You do not get another turn and you cannot direct her: she fights the enemy herself, on her own, from a separate 3,000 HP bar. Your defense is hers, so every hit aimed at her is blunted by your armour exactly as it would be if you were still standing. She hits harder than a normal strike and slips a third of all incoming attacks, dodging more the more she wins at your side. The bot plays out her every move. Triggers once per battle. If her own life runs out, the fight is truly lost.

name: Monica
description: She never got wings. She got the whole world instead: every road open, every map found.

ability.name: Beyond the Astral
ability.flavor: Free, feeless travel to every location, including hidden ground nothing else in the bot reaches.

name: Tyla & Alya
description: Two souls, one bond. Tyla splits herself to shield you from every blow that matters; Alya unmakes whatever the enemy relies on most.

ability.name: Twin Bond
ability.flavor: Tyla: any hit that would deal more than 10% of your current HP is tanked by a clone instead, so you take zero damage, up to 3 times per battle. Alya: every 3rd turn, she zeroes out a random enemy stat for 6 turns. Together, once the battle reaches turn 10: Dance of the Rain, an automatic legendary-tier twin strike.

name: Demon Lord Anastasia
description: The last hour answers to her. Anastasia does not undo your death. She simply refuses to have witnessed it, and the clock has never once argued.

ability.name: Hypnosis
ability.flavor: When you fall, in a dungeon or a duel, the hour turns back and the fight begins again from the first breath, with your enemy short 15% of the health they held. She will turn the clock twice. The third death is yours to keep.

name: Circe, the Jester
description: A trickster witch draped in stars, gold, and gambler's luck. Beneath the wide-brimmed hat and the playful smile is someone who treats every battle like a stage and every card she draws like fate itself. She never seems worried, because she already knows the house always wins, especially when she's the house.

ability.name: Wild Card
ability.flavor: Six cards erupt into the air, and she snaps her fingers to stop the wheel. Whatever it lands on, she commits to completely: 🌟 Wishing Star annihilates the enemy outright · 🎭 Fool's Gambit swaps places so the blow lands on them · 🃏 Final Dash slips the next attack entirely · 🤡 Last Laugh leaves every enemy strike 50% weaker for 10 turns · 🎪 Wings of a Butterfly fills the field with copies for 5 turns · 🦋 Vanishing Act, castable only when she is nearly gone, ends the fight and puts her safely back in town. Three draws per battle.

name: Megumi Fushiguro
description: The last heir of the Ten Shadows. He fights from the dark itself, a thousand cursed spirits at his back, and a general no sorcerer in history has ever tamed sleeping beneath them.

ability.name: Ten Shadows Technique
ability.flavor: A thousand cursed spirits swarm from his shadow, draining the enemy's life force and crushing their attack turn after turn while he heals from what they take. His Domain, Chimera Shadow Garden, floods the field, doubling the swarm and letting him slip through the dark untouched, and calls Mahoraga, the Divine General, whose Wheel adapts to any single move used against him three times over and renders it forever null.

name: Xiao
description: A watcher first and a thief second. Xiao never blocks a technique and never endures one. She studies it, and the second time you reach for it, it is already hers. Nothing she takes is ever given back.

ability.name: Thief's Eye
ability.flavor: Once per battle, she throws the enemy's own last move straight back at them, echoing at least half again as hard as the blow that taught it to her. Then the move is simply gone: whoever owned it never uses it again for the rest of the fight. Time your theft, because you only get one, and she can only copy a move that has a name.

name: Minna
description: Minna does not heal, and she does not wound. She opens the space between two people and lets it even out, and the one who was winning always has more to lose. She only works when she is nearly gone, which is why so few ever see her do it.

ability.name: Hollow Exchange
ability.flavor: Once per battle, when she is running on almost nothing, she trades her condition for the enemy's: your last sliver of health for whatever they were comfortably sitting on. It is not a heal and it is not a wound, it is an exchange, and it never takes anyone all the way down. Its entire value is when you call it.

name: Shunya
description: शून्य. Zero, the void, the space where nothing can take hold. Every curse, poison, and hex reaches for her and closes on emptiness; face her in a duel and the void hands your own malice back.

ability.name: The Empty Vessel
ability.flavor: Nothing hostile can take root in the void. Shunya is permanently immune to every negative effect there is: burn, poison, freeze, stun, blindness, weakness, frost-lock, bleed, armour-shred, and even a boss's lifespan-drain all slide off untouched. She is not unkillable. Raw force still wounds her, so she can be beaten honestly. But against another summoner the void gives back what it is given, and any debuff a duelist tries to place on her rebounds onto the caster instead.

name: Ariel
description: She does not move faster than you. She moves twice in the time you move once, and both of them are the first. Every swing she has ever thrown has a second one already standing behind it, waiting to be noticed.

ability.name: Second Transcendance
ability.flavor: A second wind that never has to be earned. Every single turn, every attack and every skill, in dungeons, co-op raids and duels alike, her strike lands and then lands again, with its own aim and its own critical. The echo rolls its own accuracy, so it can miss on its own, and it obeys defence, shields, and every guard a boss or a rival can raise. It grants no extra turn and never hurries the clock: two hits, one turn, forever.

name: Yato
description: A boy who woke up in a world of mountains and trees with no memory of ever having been anything else. Fame was only a number on a profile until he thought to point a camera at a dungeon. Now the crowd is the weapon, and ten thousand people watching a boss at once is a force the boss has no stat for.

ability.name: Live Blast
ability.flavor: Go live before the fight and let the room fill. Once per battle, *.live-blast* turns every viewer currently watching into raw force that no armour reduces: an empty stream does nothing at all, a modest crowd chips, and a full house at the height of your fame arrives heavy enough to end a 50,000 HP boss in a single moment. And should the blow that finally kills him ever land, something older than the boy refuses it. *Tear of God* gives back half of everything, once, and only ever against a strike. It cannot catch what is already inside him, so poison, burn, bleed and rot finish him regardless.

trueForm.name: Unwritten
trueForm.flavor: The crowd was never the power, only the first thing he thought to reach for. Ascended, he stops hitting what is in front of him: *.unwritten* takes part of it back out of the world, and what is taken does not come back. Healing pours into a smaller and smaller space, a boss's second wind refills a room that keeps getting narrower, and armour has no part in it because nothing is being blocked. It needs no stream, no crowd, no mana and no fame, and it can be used every single turn. It stops short of the end every time, though. The last tenth of anything has to be killed the ordinary way, and nine turns spent erasing are nine turns spent being hit. *Tear of God* still holds, once, exactly as it always did.

name: Gojo Satoru
description: The strongest there has ever been. Born with the Six Eyes and the Limitless, Gojo does not dodge and does not guard, because the space in front of him never lets you arrive. Standing against him is not a fight you are losing. It is a fight that was never yours to have.

ability.name: Limitless
ability.flavor: Infinity sits between Gojo and every blow, and it is the space itself that guards him. A strike slows the closer it gets and thins the whole way in, until it arrives at barely a third of its force, and anything small enough simply never lands. The Six Eyes read the entire battlefield, sharpening every stat he carries. Once per battle he claps Cursed Technique Lapse: Blue and Cursed Technique Reversal: Red into Hollow Purple, an imaginary mass that erases whatever stands in its path, never misses, and no armour softens. Once per battle he opens his Domain, Unlimited Void: a boundless grey where every distance is endless. The enemy is shown the birth and death of all things at once, handed infinite information with no beginning and no end, and they lock up completely, unable to move, unable to think, unable to act for as long as it holds.

name: Alexa, the Witch of Love
description: Nobody has ever put a clean hit on the Witch of Love, and not one of them could tell you why. They raise the blade, they look at her, and the reason for the swing goes missing.

ability.name: Lovestruck
ability.flavor: Whatever comes for her owner falls in love with her instead, and loses the will to finish the swing.

name: Tella, the Witch of Envy
description: The first of all witches, and the one every witch since has only been an echo of. She does not hate you. At first she does not even see you. But linger too close to the one she has chosen, take too much of what should be theirs, and something older and quieter than rage opens its eyes behind her own. Everyone she has ever envied is gone. Not beaten. Gone.

ability.name: Wonders of You
ability.flavor: She envies every soul that dares stand near her chosen one. For a while she lets it pass. The longer the fight drags on the thinner her patience wears, until she halves what you are and warns you once, softly. Stand down and be still and she may look away. Refuse, and she takes her final form, draws her chosen down to a single breath, and spends it on a forsaken spell that simply removes you from the battle. The wound it leaves does not close when the fighting stops.

name: Echidna, the Witch of Greed
description: She has read every page of the world except one, and that page is you. The Witch of Greed does not want your life, your throne or your heart - she wants everything you have, and most of the things you don't. When she smiles and pours you tea, count your pockets. When she looks away, count them again. Somewhere between the first sip and the second, half of what was yours quietly decided it was hers all along. Yet for the one she accepted - the one who burned through her refusals and kept reaching - the witch keeps a second cup warm at all times, and would sooner swallow the Gospel than ever admit it.

ability.name: Book of Wisdom
ability.flavor: The Tome of Wisdom, an infinite book that transcribes the world's own memory - every past, every present, every future - and lets her read it at the tea table without breaking a sweat, where an ordinary mind would fry just opening the cover. In battle her forbidden art takes a greedier shape: once per fight, with .greed, she slips into the enemy's pockets - even into their body for a heartbeat - and walks out carrying half their money, and sometimes their gems too, all of it handed straight to the one she chose. What she takes depends entirely on her mood. Speak to her anytime with .echidna - she is fond of her owner, and denies it furiously. A holder who pleases her may even be granted one child through her sanctuary rite, a little heir of greed who grows up in their house and steals beside her in battle.

name: Gogeta
description: Two rivals who spent their whole lives refusing to lose to each other, folded into one body for a handful of minutes. Fusion of Equals hands him strength and speed neither half could reach alone, and a clock to spend them against: when the fusion times out the boost leaves, and Big Bang Kamehameha leaves with it. Instant Transmission means the blow aimed at him arrives at empty air, and now and then he is already standing somewhere else with the next move charged. Soul Punisher is a ki blast he can throw nearly every turn. Big Bang Kamehameha needs a full energy bar, spends all of it, and erases the space between him and whatever he pointed it at.

ability.name: Fusion of Equals
ability.flavor: Strength and speed no single fighter can hold, on a timer that does not negotiate.

name: Red Rose
description: She keeps the smile of a girl at a garden party and the hands of something far older. Nothing she fights ever quite fights back the way it meant to, because the moment she takes an interest, whose body it is stops being a settled question. Everyone adores her. Almost none of them chose to.

ability.name: Puppet Strings
ability.flavor: Once per battle, no mana: she takes the strings and the enemy turns on itself. Its own attack lands on the one who threw it, run through its own guard, so the harder it hits the more it wounds itself, and then it hangs tangled for a turn and loses its next move. In a duel the strings catch their companion too. She never cuts all the way down: a puppet is worth more still dancing than broken.

name: Naruto Uzumaki (Baryon Mode)
description: Baryon Mode. He forced his own chakra and the Nine Tails together into something new and volatile, a fusion that eats through his life for every second it burns. He moves faster than the eye can follow and every blow lands like a collapsing star, but the fire he spends is his own, and the clock never stops running.

ability.name: Baryon Mode
ability.flavor: Call Kurama into the fight with .kurama, once per battle, no mana. Naruto spends his own lifespan to fuse with the Nine Tails and lands one overwhelming strike, and whatever it touches has its own lifespan torn away on top of the hit. The power is real and so is the price: the summon burns his health to fuel it, so it is a gamble as much as a finisher. Works in any dungeon, boss fight or duel.

name: Reverie
description: She and her sister were born human, two girls with no more claim on forever than anyone else. Then one of them was offered the role of a god, and Reverie is the one who said yes. She stands a half second ahead of every room she walks into, already knowing how the moment ends. When a fight turns against the one she guards, she simply decides that it will not, and the whole world waits on her word before it is allowed to move again.

ability.name: Time Stop
ability.flavor: Once per battle, no mana: she stops time with .tms. The enemy freezes where it stands and she acts alone in the stillness while the clock holds its breath, then lets it run again when she is done. Works in any dungeon, boss fight or duel.

name: Montana
description: Reverie's sister, and her opposite number. The two of them were born human, and when the role of a god was offered there was only ever one seat: Reverie took it, and Montana set out to be an adventurer instead, chasing the far edges of the world on her own two feet. Where Reverie stops the world, Montana is the one thing left in it that never stops. She fights on her own, matches whoever she stands beside step for step, and refuses to be held by anything at all.

ability.name: Faster Than Time
ability.flavor: Automatic, no command needed: equip her and she fights on her own. She carries the same strength as the one she guards, so she strikes for exactly what they would. The instant a freeze, a burn, a stun or any hold at all lands on her summoner she tears them straight back out of it before it can settle. And when anyone stops time, she moves faster than the frozen moment and strikes them back for daring to.

name: Aizen Sosuke
description: The chair was always meant for someone, and he grew past every one of them. Aizen does not scheme against the world: he edits it, and the world agrees. What you see of him is only what he has already decided you will see, and the fight was over before the first swing: the moment you looked at him and believed you knew where he was standing.

ability.name: Kyōka Suigetsu
ability.flavor: Complete Hypnosis. From the first breath of the fight, everything the enemy perceives already belongs to him: every blow aimed at Aizen is aimed at a phantom instead, and every blow that lands on nothing teaches him one more of their five senses. Sight, hearing, touch, smell, taste: steal all five and the hypnosis is complete, and every blow for the rest of the fight is misplaced without fail. Once per battle he closes Kurohitsugi, a coffin of distorted time that crushes what is already breaking: the closer to death it lands, the tighter it seals, and no armour has any part in what happens inside. And once per battle the Hōgyoku answers: his body reforges itself, the five senses fall at once, and whatever he becomes, it is out of the enemy's reach entirely.

name: Orihime Inoue
description: A gentle girl with six small spirits pinned in her hairclips. She does not heal a wound so much as refuse that it ever happened, and she has never once let go of someone she decided to protect.

ability.name: Shun Shun Rikka
ability.flavor: Passive, no command. Every turn her flowers restore 5% of your max HP, or 10% once you fall below 35%. Once per battle they reject the first poison, burn or bleed that lands on you as if it never happened, and after every won fight she mends another 15%. In duels all of it is halved.

name: Scarlett, the Witch of Lust
description: The Witch of Lust has never needed to win a fight, because her enemies keep losing their own. Desire bends toward her the way water bends downhill: kings have emptied thrones for a single evening at her table, and blades raised against her have a way of coming home to the hands that held them. She takes every attempt on her life as a compliment, and she answers each one in person.

ability.name: My Desire
ability.flavor: Passive: no command, no cost. A direct attack that lands on her may be returned to its sender in full, up to four times per battle. To strike Scarlett is to confess, and she accepts every confession at equal damage. Ronova alone is immune; there is nothing left in the Witch of Life and Death that wants, and want is the only door Scarlett opens.

name: Ronova, the Witch of Life and Death
description: The other witches wield power. Ronova decides where it ends, and her answer always arrives as a place and a time. She does not quarrel, gloat or hurry; she writes an ending and waits for the world to catch up to it. When she begins the count, the sky dims one turn at a time, and nothing that has ever been born has talked her down from three.

ability.name: The End of the World
ability.flavor: Use .endworld after five completed battle turns. Three charging turns follow, the world going dark with each one, and on the third the enemy simply ends, past every save and every revival. Only one blade has ever cut a refuge through the first phase.

name: Sword Maiden
description: Blind since before anyone thought to ask how, and entirely too cheerful about the sound of a blade leaving its sheath. She fronts The Heroes not as their shield but as their full stop: she hears the fight end in your breath, your weight, the small tell between your balance and your mistake. The witches write endings. She is the reason one of them had to be rewritten.

ability.name: Absolute Sword
ability.flavor: Five techniques drawn with .sword; charge and MP read on .ss. Her cuts cannot miss, cannot be intercepted, and never land for nothing. Transcended Sword waits through a defensive turn and stays armed for one true cut, and The Coordinate falls as three strikes resolved as one. When the world ends, her edge is the refuge that says not yet. Only the one who holds her may speak with her: .maiden <message>, and she answers in a voice made of uninterrupted warmth.
